papers.title_en: Embedding Items at Scale: Comparing GNN-Based and ID-Based Item Embeddings in the Yandex Ecosystem
papers.authors: Sergei Makeev, Artem Matveev, Vladimir Baikalov, Kirill Khrylchenko
papers.evidence: 捕获产品亲和性的大规模工业物品嵌入
papers.tldr: 在推荐系统中，物品嵌入策略直接影响模型效果与部署成本，但工业界对使用图神经网络预训练嵌入或从数据中端到端学习ID嵌入的优劣缺乏实证。本研究在Yandex电商、音乐及零售低资源场景下，全面对比两种嵌入策略的成本与性能。结果显示，训练数据有限时预训练嵌入大幅提升模型质量，但在海量数据下大规模模型端到端学习即可获得相当性能，无需额外预训练开销。该案例为大型工业推荐系统嵌入选型提供量化依据，并公开低资源数据集与代码。
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based sequential recommendation models, which process sequences of user-item interactions, rely heavily on the item embedding strategy. Existing approaches either use pretrained item embeddings or learn them end-to-end with the transformer. To the best of our knowledge, no prior work has compared these options from both cost and quality perspectives in a large-scale industrial setting. This paper is a case study that compares pretrained industrial graph neural network item embeddings with end-to-end trainable item embeddings across two mature production recommendation systems at Yandex: Yandex Market and Yandex Music. We additionally evaluate both approaches on a low-resource dataset sampled from Yandex Lavka production logs, for which both the data and code are publicly available for demonstration purposes. Our results show that a separate pretraining stage helps when training data is limited, but provides no worthwhile benefit for large-scale models trained on extensive datasets.

papers.title_en: Impute On-Demand: Adaptive Correlated Time Series Imputation for Changing Environments
papers.authors: Zhichen Lai, Huan Li, Dalin Zhang, Dong Gong, Lina Yao, Christian S. Jensen
papers.evidence: 适用于需求相关性分析的相关时间序列自适应插补
papers.tldr: 物联网应用中相关时间序列缺失值插补面临环境变化适应性不足的挑战，现有方法难以应对传感器故障与资源动态性。本文提出自适应插补模型AdaCTSi，通过解耦时空特征与稀疏空间注意力实现按需传感器子集选择。实验涵盖交通流、空气质量与轨迹数据，平均MAE降低33.1%，且单一模型即可支持传感器子集弹性推理。该方法为智能交通系统中动态缺失数据修复提供了高效、资源自适应的解决方案。
papers.abstract_en: Internet of Things (IoT) applications generate vast amounts of Correlated Time Series (CTS) data that often contain missing values and require imputation. Existing methods emphasize accuracy but often lack adaptability to changing IoT environments: they are vulnerable to sensor failures, cannot selectively impute only incomplete sensors, and use static architectures that do not adapt to resource availability. To address these limitations, we propose AdaCTSi, an adaptive CTS imputer for changing environments. AdaCTSi combines a One-shot Temporal Convolutional Network with a Learned Time-Sensor Index Table to extract and decouple complex spatio-temporal features into sensor-wise embeddings, enabling adaptation to varying sensor subsets. Sparse Spatial Attention efficiently extracts dynamic spatial correlations, while Correlation-Weighted Sensor Selection selects informative sensors to provide sufficient spatial context. Experiments with twelve baseline methods, three adaptability scenarios, and five benchmark datasets covering traffic, air quality, and trajectory data show that AdaCTSi reduces MAE by an average of 33.1% relative to the strongest baseline on each dataset. A single trained model supports sensor-subset and resource-adaptive inference, and its modest memory footprint enables deployment on commodity computing devices, including MCUs.
